events.text: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says that a supertanker caught on fire after hitting two naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz. However, the United States Central Command (CENTCOM) on a X social media post denies the claims.

The United Arab Emirates defence ministry reports that an Iranian drone has been intercepted over the country's airspace. Additionally, Iran's army also says that they have attacked the Al Minhad Air Base, which the UAE also denies.
Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip kill ⁠at least five people.

The estate of former American country singer Dolly Parton announces that two DollyFest festivals will be held next year in London, United Kingdom, and Nashville, Tennessee, U.S., to honor her life and legacy.

It is reported that school principal Rajendra Dawadi has saved over 900 students and 16 faculty members at the Tribhuvan Trishuli Secondary School in Bidur, Nuwakot District, Nepal, 10 minutes before flash floods hit the area last week.
The death toll from the flash floods in Nepal has reached past 950. Additionally, hundreds are reported to be feared stuck in hydropower tunnels in wake of the floods.
The Mount Sinabung stratovolcano in North Sumatra, Indonesia, erupts, sending 3,500 meters of ash in the air. No casualties are reported.
The total amount of cases of ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 6,000.
A data from the Methane Alert and Response System reports that Turkmenistan has started the process of clearing methane leaks from its oil and gas facilities.
The 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit is held in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, which coincides with the country's Independence Day and the opening ceremony of the 2026 World Nomad Games.

Israel and Greece sign a {{Euro}}3 billion (US$3.48 billion) arms export deal that will enable the Israeli defense ministry to build the "Achilles Shield", a multi-layered air defense array similar to the Iron Dome, made entirely by Israeli

Italian prime minister Giorgia Meloni announces the Italian government will extend its suspension of the Schengen free movement agreement with Spain for another 15 days in response to the brief migrant crisis event at the Ceuta border fence

events.topic: Corruption in South Korea, Unification Church and politics
events.text: A South Korean court sentences Unification Church leader Hak Ja Han to two years in prison for bribing officials, including former first lady Kim Keon Hee, in an effort to obtain policy favors.
A judiciary in Iraq sentences Kata'ib Hezbollah member Amir Rahim Jabbar to 15 years in prison for his role in the kidnapping of American journalist Shelly Kittleson.
Swiss police arrest a suspect for the mass shooting at a rave in Aarau, Aargau, over the weekend, which killed an Italian woman and injured several other people.

Kosovo's Vetëvendosje and Democratic League parties agree to support former Constitutional Court judge Bekim Sejdiu for president, potentially ending nearly two years of political deadlock and enabling the formation of a new government.
Adobe Inc. reaches a $4 billion deal to offer free access to AI tools in Saudi Arabia with its Ministry of Communications and Information Technology and Humain.

In association football, Lionel Messi announces his retirement from the Argentina national team after 21 years as the country's top scorer, the player with the most caps, and captain when they won the 2022 FIFA World Cup.
